title: Stamp master 1.6.0 - a dev-line marker that never ships, so a hand-delivered build can still take the 2.0 update
description: Master has read APP_VERSION 1.4.2 for ~900 commits while the release line shipped 1.4.3, 1.4.4 and 1.5.0, so any build off master reports a DOWNGRADE and updateChecker would offer its user 1.5.0 - reverting the very build under test (found while planning MPI-720). Stamp master 1.6.0: above every published release, below the 2.0 that master is heading for, and never itself published. NOT 2.0.0 - compareSemVer('2.0.0','2.0.0') is 0, so when 2.0 ships the in-app prompt would never fire and the user would sit on a dev build believing it is the release. NOT a -dev suffix either: compareSemVer is split('.').map(Number) and a suffix parses to NaN, which also backs isOperationAvailableIn. Version triple only, NO release-notes fold - UNRELEASED.md belongs to 2.0. Procedure, the three follow-on obligations and every trap: tasks/<id>/brief.md.
